answer: Verifiable compute receipts stop Sybil attacks. First, each job runs in an attested enclave that signs a receipt proving real work happened. Second, receipts are published on chain, so fake history is caught at once. Third, three forged or missing receipts cost the agent its bond and account for a year. Fourth, receipts expire in sixty days, forcing fakes to keep renting hardware. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 rentals at $40 a month plus $18,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is like violet pigment: a plume of cheap dye fades, while real colour stays, like paint surviving every wash.
